note: Private campground on the Crowsnest River at the west end of Blairmore (Crowsnest Pass), within walking distance of downtown. The riverfront sites along the east side of the park back onto the river, close enough to fish from the site; the forest-side sites face the wooded slope. Heated outdoor pool from the May long weekend to Labour Day, an on-site bistro, a river swimming hole, tent sites and two riverside cabins. The camper-van site (22 ft, no trailers) and a pull-through power/water site listed at 21 ft are too short for a 23-ft rig. In winter only electric-only sites are open. Seasonal and monthly sites are forest-side and booked by phone. The PPK and York Creek bike trails start a block away. --Claude
